Adding this to the third equation ($c^2 + d^2 = 19600$):

$\text{Saved} = (|HA| + |HB| + |HC| + |HD|) - (|HA| + |HB| + |HP|) = |HC| + |HD| - |HP|$.

2. Using hypotenuse $CD$ and altitude $h_{alt}$: $\text{Area} = \frac{1}{2} \cdot 140 \cdot h_{alt}$.

Then $h_{alt} = \frac{4200\sqrt{5}}{140} = 30\sqrt{5}$.
